notes.title: 12 LABOURS OF HERCULES XIII
notes.notes: Hello there! We are glad to see you on our stream conducted by a developer. It's devoted to the thirteen-part of Hercules series. Уou can see most of the new game mechanics, different levels, and locations. Look how we play Hercules and then test it out by yourself!
